1. अभि॑ ind. (a prefix to verbs and nouns, expressing) to, towards, into, over, upon. (As a prefix to verbs of motion) it expresses the notion of moving or going towards, approaching, &c. (As a prefix to nouns not derived from verbs) it expresses superiority, intensity, &c.; e.g. अभि-ताम्र, अभि-नव, q.v.
(As a separate adverb or preposition) it expresses (with acc.) to, towards, in the direction of, against
into, ŚBr. & KātyŚr.

on, upon, with regard to, by, before, in front of
over. It may even express one after the other, severally, Pāṇ. i, 4, 91, e.g. वृक्षं वृक्षम् अभि, tree after tree
